_comment.about: Copy this file to h3mod.local.json and edit the paths (forward slashes are fine). Each key can also be set by the environment variable named below, which wins over the file; leave a key out to use its default.
_comment.h3_game_dir: Original Heroes 3 install, the folder with Data/ and Maps/; only ever read. Env H3_GAME_DIR. No default.
_comment.vcmi_dir: Official VCMI install, the folder with VCMI_client.exe. Env VCMI_DIR. No default.
_comment.vcmi_data: VCMI user data folder (Data, Maps, Mods, Saves, config, claude-bridge). Env VCMI_DATA. Default ~/Documents/My Games/vcmi.
_comment.vcmi_build_root: Where the patched VCMI is cloned, built and installed (src, build, install, userdata...). Env VCMI_BUILD_ROOT. Default <repo>/build/vcmi.
_comment.vs_root: Visual Studio 2022 install used by tools/vcmi_src/build.bat. Env VS_ROOT. Default: found with vswhere.
_comment.conan_home: Conan cache for the VCMI build. Env CONAN_HOME. Default <vcmi_build_root>/conan.
_comment.dev_map: Map that tools/vcmi_dev_client.py starts when no --map is given, as a VCMI resource name. Env H3MOD_DEV_MAP. No default.
